1	# Invention disclosure (the inventor's own words)
2	
3	This is the ONLY authority for what the invention includes. Everything you claim must be supported here or in later messages from the user.
4	
5	Handheld vacuum lifter with grip-loss alarm
6	
7	A cordless handheld vacuum lifter is disclosed. The lifter includes a rigid body with a handle and a suction cup that carries a flexible sealing lip. An electric vacuum pump is disposed within the rigid body and draws air through a port to create a vacuum. A pressure sensor monitors the grip vacuum and drives a warning indicator when vacuum is lost. A rechargeable battery powers the electric vacuum pump. The warning indicator is configured to activate before a load can be dropped.
8	
9	1. A cordless handheld vacuum lifter comprising:
10	    a rigid body comprising a handle;
11	    a suction cup carried by the rigid body, the suction cup comprising a flexible sealing lip;
12	    an electric vacuum pump disposed within the rigid body, the electric vacuum pump configured to draw air through a port to create a vacuum;
13	    a pressure sensor configured to monitor the vacuum;
14	    a warning indicator driven by the pressure sensor, the warning indicator configured to activate when the vacuum is lost; and
15	    a rechargeable battery configured to power the electric vacuum pump.
16	
17	2. The cordless handheld vacuum lifter of claim 1, wherein the warning indicator is configured to activate before a load can be dropped.
18	
19	A cordless handheld vacuum lifter for glass and stone panels is disclosed. The lifter includes a suction cup 10 that carries a flexible sealing lip 12 on a rigid body 14. The rigid body 14 also includes a handle 16. An electric vacuum pump 20 is disposed inside the rigid body 14 and is configured to draw air through a port 22 to create a vacuum. A pressure sensor 30 monitors the grip vacuum. The pressure sensor 30 drives a warning indicator 32, which activates when vacuum is lost. The warning indicator 32 is configured to warn a user before a load can be dropped. A rechargeable battery 40 powers the electric vacuum pump 20.
